Position Description This role provides Level 3 production support for high-volume Java applications within the regulatory reporting technology landscape. The application suite sources trade and reference data, supports reporting and regulatory submissions, performs controls and reconciliations, and enables related downstream applications. In this position, you will help maintain the stability, availability, and operational resilience of business-critical trading applications. You will monitor day-to-day operations, resolve user and production issues, coordinate releases and business continuity activities, manage incidents, deliver minor bug fixes, automate repetitive processes, and support technology-risk remediation and infrastructure upgrades across global regions. Flexible working arrangements (hybrid, reviewed case-by-case basis). Feel free to contact your recruiter to learn more about how this works in practice. Essential Responsibilities As the Level 3 Application Support Engineer, you will: Provide Level 3 production support for high-volume, business-critical Java applications. Perform BAU monitoring, respond to alerts, and proactively identify issues affecting application stability, data quality, or regulatory processing. Handle user support queries and manage client interactions and regulatory escalations in a timely and professional manner. Investigate production incidents, conduct root-cause analysis, and collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to implement permanent solutions. Coordinate production releases, application upgrades, infrastructure changes, and hotfix deployments across APAC, EMEA, and AMER, with minimal operational disruption. Participate in incident, problem, and change management, including risk assessment, mitigation planning, stakeholder communication, and post-implementation validation. Support business continuity planning and disaster-recovery exercises, ensuring application readiness and adherence to recovery objectives. Troubleshoot complex technical issues across application, operating system, messaging, database, scheduling, and data layers to reduce downtime and business impact. Fix minor application defects and deliver controlled code changes in accordance with development, testing, release, and governance standards. Automate repetitive operational tasks and monitoring activities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and support responsiveness. Contribute to application enhancements by analysing requirements, implementing new features, and assessing change and incident risks. Maintain runbooks, support documentation, incident records, and operational knowledge to strengthen service continuity and team capability. Key Technical Knowledge Technologies: Java, SQL Databases and data platforms: SAP IQ, Sybase ASE, IBM DB2 Development environment: IntelliJ IDEA and Maven Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Minimum of 8-years experience in Java/SQL Hands-on experience supporting enterprise Java applications in a Level 3 production support environment. Strong working knowledge of Java and SQL, with experience troubleshooting issues across application and database layers. Experience with incident, problem, change, and release management processes in a controlled production environment. Effective written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to work with technical teams, business users, and global stakeholders. Desired Qualifications Experience supporting applications in Regulatory reporting or Financial market / industry. Working knowledge of Kafka or TIBCO EMS messaging and one or more of SAP IQ, Sybase ASE, IBM Db2, data lake platforms, or Snowflake. Experience with IntelliJ IDEA, Maven, JIRA, AutoSys, and Procmon. Scripting or automation experience for operational monitoring, support workflows, or recurring production tasks. Experience coordinating releases and production support across APAC, EMEA, and AMER regions. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, prioritisation, and root-cause analysis skills. Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and geographically distributed teams, manage competing priorities, and communicate clearly during high-severity incidents. Desired Characteristics Proven track record of working in a cross functional and virtual teams Broad technical understanding and ability to learn fast Strong team player with interpersonal, influencing and team building skills, and proven ability to work in a matrix environment Strong analytical and data evaluating skills Able to manage and resolve conflicts Clear thinker with ability to prioritize based on business objectives Strong communication skills and ability to communicate with colleagues and suppliers at all levels In addition to compensation aligned with your role, you’ll have access to a wide range of benefits that support your health, career growth, and overall well-being (SNG) Paid leave entitlements Health and Life Enrichment (HALE) program covering various well-being offerings Life insurance cover Optional health insurance cover Employer Assistance Program (EAP) Rewards and Recognition Our recruitment and selection process is designed to create the best match for both you and Infosys. Depending on the role, it may include an initial screening, technical or functional interviews, and conversations focused on cultural alignment and shared values. We are committed to making the experience transparent, respectful, and engaging at every step. Hear from our recruiter on their experience working with Infosys as an Employer At Infosys, we recognize that everyone has individual requirements. If you are a person with disability, illness, or injury and require adjustments to the recruitment and selection process, please contact our Recruitment team for adjustment either via the following email Infy_REC_Helpdesk@infosys.com or call 1-866-472-0935. Alternatively, you can include your preferred method of communication in email, and someone will be in touch. Please note in order to protect the interest of all parties involved in the recruitment process, Infosys does not accept any unsolicited resumes from third-party vendors. In the absence of a signed agreement, any submission will be deemed as non-binding and Infosys explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire the submitted profile. All recruitment activity must be coordinated through the Talent Acquisition department. “All aspects of employment at Infosys are based on merit, competence and performance. We are committed to embracing diversity and creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Infosys is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.”

Growth & Development: Comprehensive structured onboarding, personalized mentorship programs, continuous training budgets, and sponsored professional certifications. Team & Culture: Flat hierarchies, self-organized agile squads, regular team events, morning breakfast sessions, and corporate health benefits like Hansefit.

General Qualifications Civil/Structural Engineering degree for engineering positions; relevant technical qualifications for CAD drafting. review_candidates.title: Senior Runtime Performance Specialist
review_candidates.company: KIRIN NOVA REAL ESTATE L.L.C S.O.C
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Senior Runtime Performance Specialist Location: UAE (Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time Level: Senior Work Arrangement: Fully Remote — 100% Work From Home About Us We are committed to delivering high-performance, reliable, and scalable software systems through advanced runtime optimization, performance engineering, and continuous technical improvement. We are seeking an experienced Senior Runtime Performance Specialist to analyze application runtime behavior, identify performance bottlenecks, optimize resource utilization, and improve the responsiveness, stability, and efficiency of software applications and infrastructure. The successful candidate will possess strong expertise in runtime diagnostics, performance profiling, memory management, concurrency, system architecture, and application optimization. This role involves collaborating remotely with software engineers, platform teams, DevOps specialists, and technical architects to ensure applications operate efficiently under varying workloads and production conditions. Key Responsibilities Analyze application runtime behavior to identify performance bottlenecks, excessive resource consumption, latency issues, and execution inefficiencies. Conduct comprehensive performance profiling across application code, runtime environments, operating systems, virtual machines, and supporting infrastructure. Optimize CPU utilization, memory allocation, garbage collection, thread scheduling, concurrency, and other runtime characteristics. Investigate application latency, throughput limitations, resource contention, deadlocks, race conditions, and unexpected runtime failures. Develop and execute performance benchmarks, load tests, stress tests, and scalability assessments to evaluate application behavior under different workload conditions. Analyze runtime metrics, execution traces, profiling data, logs, and system telemetry to determine the root causes of performance degradation. Optimize application execution paths, algorithms, data structures, memory access patterns, and resource management strategies. Evaluate runtime environments such as Java Virtual Machine (JVM), .NET CLR, Node.js, Python, or other relevant execution platforms based on the organization's technology stack. Review garbage collection behavior, heap utilization, memory leaks, object allocation patterns, and memory fragmentation where applicable. Assess the performance impact of application frameworks, third-party libraries, runtime configuration settings, and software dependencies. Collaborate with development teams to review code, recommend optimization techniques, and implement performance improvements. Establish performance baselines, service-level objectives, capacity thresholds, and runtime health indicators for critical applications. Investigate production performance incidents, conduct root-cause analyses, and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Support capacity planning by analyzing workload patterns, resource consumption trends, traffic projections, and expected application growth. Evaluate the performance implications of software upgrades, runtime version changes, infrastructure modifications, and architectural decisions. Improve application startup time, execution efficiency, response time, throughput, and resource utilization. Design repeatable performance testing procedures and integrate automated performance checks into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines. Develop scripts and utilities to automate profiling, benchmarking, diagnostic analysis, and performance regression detection. Monitor runtime performance across development, testing, staging, and production environments to ensure consistent operational standards. Establish and maintain technical documentation covering performance findings, optimization recommendations, benchmarking methodologies, and runtime configuration guidelines. Work with cloud engineering and platform teams to optimize containerized applications, virtual machines, and cloud-hosted workloads. Evaluate observability tools, application performance monitoring platforms, distributed tracing systems, and profiling solutions. Recommend architectural improvements when performance issues originate from inefficient service communication, database access, caching strategies, or distributed processing. Mentor engineering colleagues on performance engineering techniques, profiling methodologies, runtime behavior, and optimization best practices. Maintain awareness of emerging runtime technologies, compiler optimizations, performance analysis techniques, and software engineering standards. Perform all responsibilities remotely using secure development environments, monitoring platforms, version control systems, and digital collaboration tools. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. A master's degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or Performance Engineering is an advantage. At least 5–8 years of experience in software engineering, performance engineering, runtime optimization, systems development, or application diagnostics. Demonstrated experience profiling and optimizing complex applications in production or performance-critical environments. Strong understanding of runtime execution models, memory management, garbage collection, concurrency, threading, and process scheduling. Experience with at least one major runtime ecosystem, such as Java/JVM, .NET CLR, Node.js, Python, Go, or another relevant application platform. Proficiency in one or more programming languages used for performance-sensitive applications, such as Java, C++, C#, Go, Rust, or Python. Experience using profiling and diagnostic tools to investigate CPU hotspots, memory leaks, thread contention, latency, and resource utilization. Strong knowledge of operating system fundamentals, including processes, threads, virtual memory, file systems, networking, and system resource management. Experience with performance benchmarking, load testing, stress testing, and performance regression analysis. Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, containerized workloads, and cloud-native application architectures. Knowledge of application performance monitoring, distributed tracing, centralized logging, and metrics-based observability. Experience with tools such as profilers, debuggers, benchmarking frameworks, and performance monitoring platforms relevant to the chosen technology stack. Understanding of caching strategies, database query performance, network latency, serialization overhead, and inter-service communication. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks for integrating performance checks into software delivery workflows. Ability to interpret complex performance data and translate findings into practical engineering improvements. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain performance findings to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Experience preparing technical reports, documenting optimization strategies, and presenting measurable performance improvements. Ability to manage multiple investigations, prioritize high-impact issues, and work independently in a fully remote environment. High standards of code quality, technical accuracy, security awareness, and engineering discipline. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Application Response Time: Improve response times and reduce latency across critical application workflows. Runtime Efficiency: Reduce unnecessary CPU consumption, memory usage, and runtime overhead. Throughput Improvement: Increase application processing capacity without compromising reliability or correctness. Performance Stability: Minimize performance degradation, resource exhaustion, and runtime-related incidents. Memory Optimization: Identify and resolve memory leaks, excessive allocations, and inefficient memory utilization. Scalability: Improve application performance under increasing workloads and concurrent user activity. Incident Resolution: Diagnose and resolve runtime performance issues within agreed service-level targets. Regression Prevention: Reduce performance regressions through automated benchmarks and continuous monitoring. Optimization Delivery: Implement measurable improvements against established performance baselines. Diagnostic Accuracy: Identify root causes efficiently and provide evidence-based recommendations. Documentation Quality: Maintain clear performance reports, reproducible benchmarks, and reliable technical documentation. Engineering Collaboration: Support development and platform teams in adopting effective performance optimization practices. What We Offer Competitive compensation based on qualifications, experience, and technical expertise. 100% fully remote work arrangement , with no routine office attendance required. Opportunities to solve challenging runtime performance problems across modern software systems. Exposure to advanced profiling tools, performance engineering practices, cloud platforms, and distributed architectures. A collaborative engineering environment that values technical excellence, measurable improvements, and continuous learning. Opportunities for professional development and career advancement in performance engineering and systems optimization. Access to digital collaboration tools and secure technical environments that support effective remote work. A performance-oriented culture focused on software quality, system reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
